author: Gi3kr
quote: I wanted to love GTA 6, but after the first few hours, the detail stopped making up for how repetitive it felt. The missions rely too heavily on driving somewhere, getting into a shootout, and escaping the cops. There’s plenty happening around you, yet surprisingly little freedom in how you approach the main story. The controls feel sluggish, especially indoors, and a few failed missions came down to fighting the movement rather than making an actual mistake. The writing has its moments, but some of the dialogue tries so hard to be funny that it takes the tension out of scenes. It’s a good technical achievement. I just wish the missions were as ambitious as the world around them.
